hero.title: I build things until they work, then hope it doesn't break
hero.lede: I'm Jakacraft — I like experimenting with things, and I have spent more time than I like to admit finishing up things that where "done" three hours ago

paragraphs: I'm Jakacraft — a self-taught developer who got into this because I wanted to build the things I couldn't find, and stayed because I like the moment something finally compiles after an hour of staring at the same error.
Most of what I make starts as a small, slightly stubborn side project: a tool that fixes one annoyance, a script that saves me ten minutes, a game system that only makes sense to me.
And yes, I still barely know what I'm doing.

stats.v: taking a break to learn new things

projects.name: caffeine-dungeons
projects.desc: A small QoL mod for the Minecraft server DungeonDodge, mostly with features I want to make my life easier
